corrections.previous: Analysis of PBMCs or puriﬁed monocyte lysates harvested at baseline used antibodies against human signal transducer and activator of transcription-3 (STAT3), phosphorylated-STAT3 ( p-STAT3) Y705, and p-STAT3 S727

blind_answer.quote: Analysis of PBMCs or purified monocyte lysates harvested at baseline used antibodies against human signal transducer and activator of transcription-3 (STAT3), phosphorylated-STAT3 (p-STAT3) Y705, and p-STAT3 S727 (all from Cell Signaling Technology), dual-specificity phosphatase 1 (DUSP1; Sigma-Aldrich), phospho-DUSP1 (p-DUSP1) S359 (Cell Signaling Technology), and p-DUSP1 S296 (OriGene Technologies).
